programs.description: Elderly residents in a care home grapple with abandonment and their new reality. Fate intervenes, serving justice to their ungrateful children who deserted them in their time of need.
Listen to a comprehensive compilation of some of the most melodious classic tunes one after the other in quick succession.
A subject-matter expert conducts an informative lecture on songs composed by Rabindranath Tagore with suitable examples in a detailed and easy-to-understand manner.
Ujan falls in love with Mishti, his childhood friend, but she gets married to Sid. Mishti dies in a car accident and leaves her daughter in Ujan's care.
Kumar moves to Bombay for work and stays with his twin brother Shankar. Amid music, family ties and romance, Kumar falls in love with Reeta, Geeta's younger sister.
A lifelong friendship between Neel, Akash and Chandni faces turmoil when family expectations reshape their futures and strain unspoken feelings.
A patriarch's rigid belief in horoscopes causes family rifts, but he ultimately learns to accept change and new perspectives.
An inebriated Udayan spends a night with his friend's daughter, Kunti, mistaking her to be his wife. He leaves unaware the next morning, setting off a chain of chaotic events.
